title: Deeply Personal
description: Unvarnished honesty, lessons learned the hard way, personal courage, and authentic truth.
questions: What is a lesson you had to learn the hard way that permanently changed you?

What is something you're afraid people would judge you for if they knew the unfiltered truth?
When was a time in your life when you felt completely lost, and how did you find your footing?
What is your deepest, most persistent insecurity, and where do you think it originated?
Have you ever made a sacrifice for someone else that went completely unnoticed or unappreciated?
What was a season in your life where you felt profoundly lonely, even when surrounded by others?
What is a mistake in your career or education that you wish you could undo?
What is something you did that you feel genuinely ashamed of?
What is a boundary you allowed someone to cross that you still wish you had defended?
What is a dream or ambition you quietly gave up on, and do you ever mourn it?
When was the last time you wept openly, and what was behind those tears?
What is the hardest truth someone who loves you ever had to tell you about yourself?

What is a fear about getting older that occasionally keeps you awake at night?
What was the most emotionally painful chapter of your life, and what carried you through it?

What was the most courageous decision you've ever made in your personal life?
When was a time when your pride or ego got in the way of doing the right thing?
What is something you find very difficult to ask other people for help with?
What is a part of your personality that you used to hide, but have learned to embrace?
Have you ever experienced a betrayal that permanently altered how you trust people?
What is something you wish you could say to someone who is no longer in your life?
What does your inner critic sound like when you fail at something you care about?

If you knew you only had one year left in full health, what would you immediately change about your days?
